paper.citation: Warren et al. (2024), Data-driven discovery of potent small molecule ice recrystallisation inhibitors

review_mode: bounded read-only text inspection; public source files downloaded through scripts/with_external_storage.py; no public code executed

warren_md_parameters.trajectory_use: final conformation for H-wACSF/SOAP; hydration descriptors averaged over 100 trajectory conformations
warren_md_parameters.state_selection: Diamorphite-DL predictions over pH 6.5–7.5, precision 1.0; manual choice using literature pKa or MolGpKa; random sample independently checked
warren_md_parameters.hydration_histogram: water oxygen to all solute atom distances; 100 bins over 0–0.5 nm (0.005 nm bins), normalized probability density
warren_md_parameters.hydration_numbers_indices: seven fixed cutoffs 0.20–0.50 nm, first/second solvation-shell minima, and geometric H-bond count; divide by RDKit MW, SASA, or volume; only volume indices trained

assay.conditions: Amino: splat cooling, 20 mM compound in 10 mM NaCl
assay.procedure: 10 µL drop from 1.4 m onto −78 °C coverslip; anneal 30 min at −8 °C; manually count crystals/FOV; % MGS relative to 10 mM saline ice-growth control
assay.activity: smaller % MGS is stronger IRI; 70% classification threshold; <20% described as highly active

public_artifact_findings.DOLMEN: CSV datasets expose names, SMILES, concentrations, % MGS, errors, set labels and descriptor tables; no per-compound .top/.itp/.gro/.xtc or GROMACS inputs in the inspected repository tree
public_artifact_findings.HIN: README requires GROMACS .xtc paired with .gro and recursive tree has generic examples/Fortran postprocessors; no Amino target structures/topologies/trajectories in the inspected repository tree
public_artifact_findings.Zenodo: DOLMEN record has only DOLMEN-v1.0.0.zip (6.34 MB); HIN record only HIN-V2.0.0.zip (60.56 MB)
public_artifact_findings.WRAP_dataset_record: https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/187155/ resolves to the separate Warren et al. dataset record and exposes one public file, Source Data.xlsx (https://wrap.warwick.ac.uk/id/eprint/187155/1/Source%20Data.xlsx). The inspected inventory contains source data only; it does not list per-compound coordinates, topology, or trajectories.

recommended_controls.role: small matched isomer pair; primary minimal control
recommended_controls.matching: same assay/salt/concentration and C3H7NO2 composition; alpha/beta connectivity is a compact geometry/state test
recommended_controls.caveat: neither endpoint is extreme; alpha-alanine uncertainty is large
different size/chemotype; assay range control rather than matched perturbation

structure_protonation_limitations: DOLMEN SMILES are public molecular inputs, not simulation coordinates/topologies.
Paper gives a state-selection procedure but no per-compound state table or exact CHARMM36 residue/patch/charge assignment was found.

Phase 9 audit finds 15/63 locked Amino rows with approximately ±1.0073 Da descriptor-vs-SMILES mass mismatch, consistent with possible protonation/deprotonation but not proof; named hydrochloride/chloride rows omit chloride in supplied SMILES.
Preserve exact DOLMEN SMILES as identifiers; document any reconstructed CHARMM36 state/net charge and label it reconstruction.

viable_minimal_pilot_route.route: Reconstruct l-alpha-alanine and beta-alanine first; optionally add l-phenylalanine and glycine. Generate 3D conformers from exact SMILES, state pH assumption and net charge, parameterize CHARMM36-compatible, solvate 4 nm TIP4P/Ice cube, run 273 K for 20 ns, sample 100 frames, calculate oxygen-to-solute histograms and cutoff/H-bond counts.
viable_minimal_pilot_route.comparison: Compare reconstructed descriptors qualitatively with DOLMEN hydhist/hydidx rows where present; do not call it a Warren reproduction without missing topology, charge, equilibration, integrator/cutoff/constraints, frame stride, and state choices being recovered or justified.
viable_minimal_pilot_route.compute_scope: Two compounds are the smallest useful matched pilot; four provide compact active/inactive range. HIN is a postprocessor once .gro/.xtc exist.

missing_state_parameters: CHARMM36 residue naming, atom typing, partial charges, terminal patches/custom parameters
minimization/equilibration, thermostat/barostat, timestep, constraints, PME/cutoffs, output stride and seeds
